=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:5182-5183, 5196-5200, 5419-5443; .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5353, 5713 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A lite-tier pass with Mistral as its sole reviewer can exit successfully with zero successful reviewers after a retryable infrastructure failure.
  WHY: A retryable Mistral failure without a failback is recorded as skipped_unmapped; an open circuit breaker can produce skipped_open. The GPT retry requires status failed and a context-overflow match, so neither skipped status triggers it. The zero-success guard then treats those statuses as fail-open and exits 0. The workflow’s reviewer-audit check runs only when REVIEWERS_SUCCESSFUL is greater than zero, and its auto-merge condition does not require a successful reviewer. A clean editor no-op can therefore proceed toward auto-merge
